scope: All generated verification source text and decoded JSON receipts in this directory, before publication.
included: Authorized public project source/resource identities, exact hashes/counts, reproduction code, synthetic negative-control descriptions and scoped qualifications.
excluded: Credentials, secret values, private links, unrelated private data, internal control identifiers and execution-local paths.
encoding: UTF-8 text/JSON only; no opaque or compressed payloads.
qualification: This is a scoped semantic/content inspection, not a universal secret-detection guarantee.
